title: From Prediction to Intervention: Personalized Meal-Level Glucose Regulation via an LLM Agent
abstract: arXiv:2608.13581v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personalized glucose regulation remains a central yet unresolved challenge in precision nutrition, as postprandial glucose response varies substantially across individuals. Existing approaches based on glycemic indices fail to adequately account for such heterogeneity and lack the mechanism to dynamically adjust meals based on personal physiological feedback. In this context, recent advances in LLM-based agents offer a promising direction, as they enable context-aware reasoning and iterative refinement. Inspired by this, we propose a physio-feedback agentic loop, a unified system that integrates individualized absorption modeling with dietary intervention to regulate glucose response. Specifically, we develop a Physiology-Aware Glucose Predictor to model individualized absorption dynamics through a learnable Temporal Physiological Absorption Decay Module. translated_title: 从预测到干预：通过LLM智能体实现个性化餐食级血糖调控
translated_abstract: 个性化血糖调控仍是精准营养中一个核心但尚未解决的挑战，因为餐后血糖反应在个体间存在显著差异。现有的基于血糖指数的方法未能充分解释这种异质性，并且缺乏根据个人生理反馈动态调整餐食的机制。在此背景下，基于LLM智能体的最新进展提供了一个有前景的方向，因为它们能够实现上下文感知推理和迭代优化。受此启发，我们提出了一种生理反馈智能体循环，这是一个统一系统，将个体化吸收建模与饮食干预相结合以调控血糖反应。具体而言，我们开发了一个生理感知血糖预测器，通过一个可学习的时变生理吸收衰减模块来建模个体化吸收动态。然后，我们构建了一个预测驱动的两阶段餐食优化智能体，它进行迭代...
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合生理感知血糖预测器和LLM驱动的两阶段餐食优化智能体的统一系统，实现了从个性化血糖预测到动态饮食干预的闭环调控。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified system combining a physiology-aware glucose predictor and an LLM-driven two-stage meal optimization agent, enabling closed-loop regulation from personalized glucose prediction to dynamic dietary intervention.
